scope: Production Python frame loop over two Windows OS pipes, Windows Job with two controlled processes, local SQLite. The Tauri renderer and Ollama inference are outside this run.
setup: Fresh temporary office per run. One accepted report in B and an active model fixture in A. Read B history and report through two independent held callbacks, queue two observers, refuse a fifth. Discard the first stop reply and retry after reconnecting; release B only after termination is observed.
measurement: Elapsed milliseconds from before client write to first successful independent SQLite read of CANCELLATION_REQUESTED. Observations poll at a requested 3 ms interval. Includes OS scheduling.
stats: Median and nearest-rank p95, all observations included.
